description: A ground-level photograph depicting a wide, open grassland landscape under a hazy sky. The foreground is dominated by lush green grasses, with some taller, drier-looking vegetation visible on the right. In the middle ground, scattered trees and shrubs are visible, along with a distant cluster of buildings, possibly a village, nestled amongst rolling hills. More hills are visible in the background under a light blue to white sky. The photo is attributed "© Copernicus | CLMS 2019".
